2026-10-13 — Complete A03 on Java main revision 006a92e65e07412cb7caf603f853c90c58b86f5e. StageTiming now derives deterministic
elapsed results from committed TimingData plus current EventData/ReserveTagMap/StageStartTimes state, with explicit unresolved
outcomes and an explicit ZoneId for civil-time rollover. REV/lifecycle records do not become new stage passages. Ranking remains
a future query policy because no ranking/tie/grouping rule is currently specified.
2026-10-13 — Complete A02 on Java main revision 99d1d5839c7f837d19095f3b253708728952cdc1. The UpstreamData base, ordered
per-node RACE_DATA sequence, ReserveTagMap and StageStartTimes SET/DEL state, apply-before-ACK semantics, gap-to-REQ behavior,
node UpstreamMessagePort and application UpstreamMessageRouter are implemented and qualified by Java verification and runtime
2026-10-13 — Close A01/V01 by requalifying the existing multi-topology baseline on Java main revision
7d87344725d9deb8c91bfda524b35c085b53b401. VC-ST1-007 and VC-ST1-008 both pass in the integrated -Psystem-test run, confirming
independent node addressing, sequence isolation, separate LogBooks and restart recovery.
2026-10-13 — Complete D04 engineering upstream transport design. EngineeringApiUpstreamConnector reuses IF-03 POST
/api/v1/dev/upstream/message and the existing SI-02 event WebSocket with role=upstream; outbound semantic messages are
UPSTREAM_DATA events. No second listener port or SI-02 WebSocket lifecycle is added. SI-02 acts as the Central System Simulator
and the connector enters the same UpstreamData boundary as RabbitMQ.
2026-10-13 — Complete the D02/D03 ordered-stream model before A02 implementation. TIMING_DATA keeps the existing per-node
LogBook/IF-05 seqNr. Central-to-node RACE_DATA gets its own per-node source seq and carries incremental
reserveTagMap/StageStartTimes changes. SI-01 ACKs RaceData only after ordered semantic application; gaps cause bidirectional REQ
from the first missing sequence. SYNC advertises a stream's source head. REQ TIMING_DATA fromSeq=1 is the semantic equivalent of
2026-10-13 — Complete the D01 IF-06 baseline. Use one bidirectional UpstreamData model with a public/reference JSON
representation: TIMING_DATA embeds structured IF-05 records, while PING uses op=REQ/ANS with optional mode=HB and optional
pingId. SI-01 sends heartbeat REQ immediately on connect/reconnect and every 30 seconds; manual PING omits mode. No
unanswered-PING timeout policy is fixed yet.
2026-10-13 — Use one SI-02 Central System Simulator with two transports: IF-03 for deterministic ST-2 and RabbitMQ for hosted
ST-3. Both exercise the same semantic upstream contract; deployment-specific protocol mappings remain below the UpstreamData
2026-10-13 — Activate Step 7 after Step 6 closeout and adopt the existing multi-node, node-addressing, separate-LogBook and
restart-recovery implementation as the baseline instead of rebuilding that topology. Continue with reference-data,
synchronization and backoffice integration work from that baseline.
